metadata.author: Ama Owusu
metadata.description: Debut literary novel set in contemporary Accra, following three generations of the Boateng-Asante family through the lens of a glass-blower's workshop; published by Cassava Press; longlisted for the Etisalat Prize for Literature

steps.prompt: I'm preparing a review of a 2023 debut novel I've been assigned: Glassy-eyed by Ama Owusu, published by Cassava Press. I've heard it was longlisted for the Etisalat Prize. Can you find background on the book — the author's background, early critical reception, and what reviewers have said about it so far?
